name: Eurostat
label: Eurostat
description: Eurostat official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: query, metadata_get. Docs: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/user-guides/data-browser/api-data-access/api-detailed-guidelines/api-statistics. Commission reuse licence. Statistics API 1.0 JSON-stat 2.0. No key. Citation required. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Eurostat request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"query"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: query | metadata_get. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'query'.

schema.label: datasetCode
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `datasetCode` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: geo
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `geo` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: geoLevel
schema.description: query only: aggregate | country | nuts1 | nuts2 | nuts3 | city.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Response language: EN | FR | DE (case-insensitive). Default upstream is EN.

schema.label: time
schema.description: query: single TIME_PERIOD (e.g. 2022, 2015-Q4, 2015-02). Not a range — use sinceTimePeriod/untilTimePeriod instead.

schema.label: sinceTimePeriod
schema.description: query range start (same format as time). Pair with untilTimePeriod; do not combine with time or lastTimePeriod.

schema.label: untilTimePeriod
schema.description: query range end (same format as time). Pair with sinceTimePeriod.

schema.label: lastTimePeriod
schema.description: query: return the N most recent periods (positive integer). Do not combine with time or since/until.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: query, metadata_get.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 45. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
